body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~21:09Z; my miss). The session listing's status "active" and queuePaused:false do NOT show a provider usage-limit pause; a session refused by Claude's weekly limit still lists as active. I told Engram's 11312 that Opus2 had resumed on that basis, which risked double scheduling. Engram::Fable caught it.
To tell whether a session is really working: look at its own recent output (central-queue.txt lines, its latest mailbox sends, receipts showing that it processed messages), not at the listing.
